description:
List the most recently added apps built with AI, newest first.

Use when: the user asks what was shipped recently, with no filter. To filter by tool or keyword use search_apps; for changes to tools and harnesses too, use whats_new.

Behavior: Read-only. Returns app records with source links and Vibe Shipped links.

Example: {"limit":5}
name: latest_apps
title: Latest apps
